page_title: LEC 0-1 NAP | Lecce v Napoli 03/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+7' Tete Morente (Lecce) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
90+3' Napoli are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.

89' Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) receives a quality pass and unleashes a rocket of a shot from distance, but his amazing effort goes just over the crossbar. The goalkeeper probably wouldn't have saved this one.
88' Antonio Conte has decided to substitute Matteo Politano and he is replaced by Cyril Ngonge (Napoli).
87' The manager makes a subsitution with Giovanni Simeone (Napoli) coming on for Romelu Lukaku.
87' Tete Morente (Lecce) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
87' A rebound spins to Matteo Politano (Napoli) inside the box, but his sliced shot flies just wide of the right post.
86' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
84' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Santiago Pierotti as he is replaced by Konan Ndri (Lecce).
84' Medon Berisha (Lecce) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Alex Meret, who smothers the ball.
82' Davide Massa shows a yellow card to Tete Morente (Lecce) for his blatant foul.
81' Kialonda Gaspar (Lecce) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
79' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Philip Billing (Napoli) is coming onto the pitch as Giacomo Raspadori cannot continue after picking up an injury.
74' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.

74' Ambitious effort from Tete Morente (Lecce). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar.

74' Danilo Veiga (Lecce) attempted to send a defence-splitting pass into space where Santiago Pierotti was lurking. It could have put him one-on-one with the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players somehow manages to avert the threat.
71' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!
70' Total attempts – 6:6. Shots on target – 1:2.
67' The free kick from a promising distance is taken by Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce), who fires in a direct effort just wide of the left post. What a chance!
67' Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) is penalised for holding. Davide Massa signals a set piece. Lecce earn a free kick.
66' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
65' Marco Giampaolo prepares a substitution. Balthazar Pierret is replaced by Medon Berisha (Lecce).
65' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) is caught offside once again.
62' Here comes a substitution. Frederic Guilbert is given a rest as he is replaced by Danilo Veiga (Lecce).
62' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.

61' Tete Morente (Lecce) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players. Lecce earn a corner.
57' Matteo Politano (Napoli) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
57' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked. The referee blows his whistle, Napoli are awarded a corner kick.
56' Scott McTominay (Napoli) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
54' The corner from Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce) is cleared away by the defence.
54' Problems for Antonio Conte as Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Billy Gilmour replaces him.
53' Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

52' Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going into the roof of the net, but Alex Meret has other ideas and makes a brilliant save. Lecce force their opponents to concede a corner.
51' Frederic Guilbert (Lecce) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Davide Massa no option but to blow his whistle.
50' Goal disallowed! Mathias Olivera (Napoli) scores but Davide Massa blows his whistle for a foul.
50' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) will take a corner kick.
49' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Napoli get a corner.
47' The ball is cleared after Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Marco Giampaolo probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Jesper Karlsson (Lecce). He is replaced by Thorir Johann Helgason.
46' Marco Giampaolo makes a half-time substitution. Tete Morente comes on in place of Mohamed Kaba (Lecce).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+10' The match has reached half-time.
45+9' Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
45+8' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) sends a cross into the box, but Alex Meret comes off his line to gather the ball.
45+7' It doesn’t look good for Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli); looks like he’ll have to leave the pitch!
45+6' Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
45+5' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball is behind the touchline and Lecce will take a throw-in.
45+5' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
45+2' A crossfield pass from Federico Baschirotto (Lecce) fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Napoli.
45+1' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) is able to continue to play.
45' The fourth official shows 8 min. of added time.
45' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
44' Scott McTominay plays a lovely pass into Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli), but he can't find the target. His strike from inside the box goes narrowly wide of the right post.
43' Neat passing move from Napoli in order to create new attacking opportunities.
39' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) gets a shot away from distance, but wasn't really set to take it and fires well wide of the left post.
38' Referee Davide Massa signals NO PENALTY for Lecce after a VAR review!
38' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Lecce! Let's see what he decides.
37' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
37' Kialonda Gaspar (Lecce) sees his header crash off the crossbar after meeting a corner kick inside the six-yard box. The goalkeeper would have been helpless.
37' Jesper Karlsson (Lecce) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.

37' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The ball goes out of play. Lecce are awarded a corner kick.
35' Matteo Politano (Napoli) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Wladimiro Falcone intercepts the ball.
32' A cross into the box from Frederic Guilbert (Lecce) is cleared.
30' A cooling break is underway.
26' Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) sends a long cross over to Romelu Lukaku, but Wladimiro Falcone comes forward to gather the ball.
25' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 1:3. The current number of shots on goal is 0:2.
24' 0 - 1 Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) shoots from the free kick just outside the box and curls the ball inside the right post. What a brilliant goal that is!
22' Mohamed Kaba (Lecce) trips an opposition player and Davide Massa signals a foul. Napoli have a free kick from a promising distance.

22' Scott McTominay (Napoli) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) is left with the simplest of tasks from close in after a lucky rebound off one of his own teammates, but somehow he slams his shot well wide of the right post.
20' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar.
19' Matteo Politano (Napoli) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
18' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) passes the ball onto Nikola Krstovic, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
17' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
16' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) is caught offside!
15' Jesper Karlsson (Lecce) takes the corner but it's cleared.
14' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) wins a header inside the box after a cross and steers it goalwards, but Wladimiro Falcone produces a wonderful reflex save.
13' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
12' The match can continue after the interruption.
7' The match will be interrupted for a while due to some disturbances.
6' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
5' Matteo Politano (Napoli) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Giovanni Di Lorenzo. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
4' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Napoli players look gutted.
4' The Napoli players halt their celebrations as referee Davide Massa makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.

2' Goal! Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) shows good awareness inside the box as he latches on to a brilliant pass and fires a first-time shot into the bottom right corner. Matteo Politano assisted in the goal. 0:1.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Napoli will have the kick-off.
The match will be delayed due to minute of silence.
Davide Massa will supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
